outcomes: The Cloud cache provider resolves the remote cache configuration and the materialization mode of a session, and tells the core the mode it resolved
nonGoals: Changing how the provider reads .putnami/cache.json, the PUTNAMI_CACHE_* variables or the default of a linked workspace
A new protocol version. provider-configuration is a capability of the v1 bootstrap

requirements.text: The session mode is the core's intent, else the configured mode, else full.
